mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tournament_matches (id, tournament_id, group_name, player1_id, player2_id, scheduled_time, result, winner_id, status, create_time, update_time, delete_flag) VALUES (#{id}, #{tournamentId}, #{groupName}, #{player1Id}, #{player2Id}, #{scheduledTime}, #{result}, #{winnerId}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tournament_matches WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE tournament_matches SET result = #{result}, winner_id = #{winnerId}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT tm.id, tm.tournament_id, tm.group_name, tm.player1_id, tm.player2_id, p1.name as player1_name, p2.name as player2_name, tm.scheduled_time, tm.result, tm.winner_id, tm.status FROM tournament_matches tm LEFT JOIN user p1 ON tm.player1_id = p1.id LEFT JOIN user p2 ON tm.player2_id = p2.id WHERE tm.tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND tm.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY tm.group_name, tm.scheduled_time

SELECT tm.group_name as group_name, tm.id as match_id, tm.tournament_id as match_tournament_id, tm.player1_id as match_player1_id, tm.player2_id as match_player2_id, p1.name as match_player1_name, p2.name as match_player2_name, tm.scheduled_time as match_scheduled_time, tm.result as match_result, tm.winner_id as match_winner_id, tm.status as match_status FROM tournament_matches tm LEFT JOIN user p1 ON tm.player1_id = p1.id LEFT JOIN user p2 ON tm.player2_id = p2.id WHERE tm.tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND tm.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY tm.group_name, tm.scheduled_time
SELECT * FROM tournament_matches WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND group_name = #{groupName} AND delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY scheduled_time
